title: Release a customer-ready AURO product
objective: Complete the runtime, product, evidence, and launch work as one durable integrated mission.

workstreams.title: Production runtime
workstreams.objective: Implement the production runtime, validate failure behavior, and produce API evidence.
acceptance_criteria: runtime imports from a clean environment

workstreams.title: Customer product
workstreams.objective: Prepare the installable application, account flow, documentation, and customer onboarding.

workstreams.title: Evidence and release governance
workstreams.objective: Create the claim-to-evidence matrix, regression plan, release gate, and operator checklist.
acceptance_criteria: every release claim has an evidence class
promotion and rollback authority are explicit

workstreams.title: Launch delivery
workstreams.objective: Prepare the market-facing summary, release notes, pricing assumptions, and launch sequence.
acceptance_criteria: launch material agrees with verified product capability

deliverables.title: Release Report
acceptance_criteria: blockers and residual risks are explicit
